capability: source-lineage separation for evolvable MarketDesk extractor releases
source_of_truth: Git commit plus current release manifest
changes: Preserve the original recovery manifest as immutable provenance.
Define SHA256SUMS as the current release manifest governed by Git review.
Allow later source-owned runtime releases to update SHA256SUMS plus this release receipt without rewriting historical import evidence.
non_goals: No runtime payload bytes change in this baseline release.

No MarketDesk authentication or browser-profile effect.
No queue, database, bucket, scheduler, workflow, or publication-authority change.
